about: The only hosts, site and brand names, address paths and vendor selectors the shipped files may hold. Reviewed by hand; each entry says why it is here. tests/unit/hygiene-hosts.test.js fails on any other, and on an entry nothing uses. Class tokens and class tests have no entries: no site's markup is allowed.
